subject.title: Doubao: support Volcengine Agent Plan bearer keys via /api/plan/v3

question: Should CodexBar support Agent Plan bearer keys directly through `/api/plan/v3`, or standardize on the newly merged arkcli plan-usage workflow for Agent Plan accounts?
rationale: The two paths use different authentication and endpoint assumptions, and VISION.md requires maintainer sign-off for provider-auth behavior changes; the reporter has not yet confirmed whether arkcli covers their bearer-key-only setup.

options.title: Validate arkcli coverage first
options.body: Ask the reporter to try the merged arkcli workflow and retain this issue only if that supported route cannot serve the bearer-key-only setup.

options.title: Add direct bearer support
options.body: Approve a narrow Agent Plan endpoint-selection or 401 fallback design with regression coverage for both Coding Plan and Agent Plan keys.

options.title: Document arkcli as the supported route
options.body: If arkcli intentionally replaces direct Agent Plan bearer probing, document that boundary and close after reporter confirmation.

recommendation.title: Validate arkcli coverage first
recommendation.body: Ask the reporter to try the merged arkcli workflow and retain this issue only if that supported route cannot serve the bearer-key-only setup.

likelyOwner.reason: The owner’s current comment asks the decisive compatibility question and the repository vision delegates provider-auth behavior changes to maintainer sign-off.
